INTRO.TITLE: Who is Captain Mohamed Essam?
INTRO.P1: Mohamed Essam is an online fitness coach who works with people who want a clearer path: training that fits their level, nutrition they can live with, and someone who stays with them after the plan is written.
INTRO.P2: The work is not a generic program. It is a personal system — built around the goal, the schedule, and the ability to stay consistent.

STORY.TITLE: The journey started here

ONE.TITLE: Take the work seriously
ONE.TEXT: Fitness is treated as a craft: clear training, honest nutrition, and a standard you can repeat.

TWO.TITLE: Make it personal
TWO.TEXT: The plan is shaped around the person — their goal, their time, and what they can actually commit to.

THREE.TITLE: Stay in the process
THREE.TEXT: The value is not a file you receive once. It is follow-up, adjustment, and the discipline to keep going.

PHILOSOPHY.TITLE: My coaching philosophy
PHILOSOPHY.LEAD: No one-size-fits-all plans. No extremes that collapse after two weeks.

FIT.TITLE: Training that fits you
FIT.TEXT: Your program is built around your goal, your level, and how consistently you can show up.

NUTRITION.TITLE: Nutrition without the noise
NUTRITION.TEXT: A practical way of eating you can live with — not a temporary system you abandon.

FOLLOWUP.TITLE: Ongoing follow-up
FOLLOWUP.TEXT: You do not just receive a plan and leave. There is review, adjustment, and accountability as you progress.

CONSISTENCY.TITLE: Consistency over spikes
CONSISTENCY.TEXT: The aim is not a fast result that disappears. It is a body and a routine you can maintain.

ONLINE_COACHING.TITLE: Why online coaching?
ONLINE_COACHING.LEAD: Because a useful plan has to work in your actual week — not only in a perfect gym schedule.

PLAN.TITLE: A plan built for you
PLAN.TEXT: Training and nutrition shaped around your goal and your capacity.

ANYWHERE.TITLE: Train where you are
